query_info.key_query: SELECT A.AMSYS_ATFL_ID||'_'||B.ATFL_SRNO AS "docid" , A.AMSYS_ATFL_ID AS "amsysAtflId" , B.ATFL_SRNO AS "atflSrno" FROM SGEOWN.MSGE006ITM A INNER JOIN SGEOWN.MSGE007ITF B ON A.AMSYS_ATFL_ID = B.AMSYS_ATFL_ID WHERE 1=1 AND A.DAT_USG_YN='Y' AND B.DAT_USG_YN='Y' AND B.AMSYS_ATFL_LCA_TXT LIKE '/%' AND B.AMSYS_ATFL_LCA_TXT NOT LIKE '/ABC%' AND B.AMSYS_ATFL_LCA_TXT NOT LIKE '/OTR%' AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(B.AMSYS_ATFL_LCA_TXT, '^/[0-9]{8}$') ORDER BY A.AMSYS_ATFL_ID ASC, B.ATFL_SRNO ASC
query_info.data_query: SELECT A.AMSYS_ATFL_ID||'_'||B.ATFL_SRNO AS "docid" , '40000' AS "collapse_CD" , A.AMSYS_ATFL_ID AS "amsysAtflId" , B.ATFL_SRNO AS "atflSrno" , B.AMSYSATFL_NM AS "title" , B.AMSYS_ATFL_PHsc_NM AS "amsysAtflPhscNm" , B.AMSYS_AFTL_LCA_TXT AS 'amsysAtfLcaTxt" , B.AMSYS_ATFL_OTLN_TXT AS "amsysAtflOtlnTXT" , ( SELECT C.DTLS_CD_NM M FROM SGEOWN.MSGE001ITC AS C WHERE C.DTLS_CD_ID = (REGEXP_SUBSTR(B.AMSYS_ATFL_LCA_TXT, '[^/]+', 1, 1)) ) AS "category_full" , B.FILE_OPBL_YN AS "fileOpblYN" , A.DAT_USG_YN AS "msUsgYN" , B.DAT_USG_YN AS "fileUsgYN" , SUBSTR(B.FST_DB_RGS_DTM,0,4) || '-' || SUBSTR(B.FST_DB_RGS_DTM,5,2) || '-' || SUBSTR(B.FST_DB_RGS_DTM,7,2) AS "reg_dtm" , SUBSTR(B.LST_DB_CHG_DTM,0,4)|| '-'|| SUBSTR(B.LST_DB_CHG_DTM,5,2)|| '-' || SUBSTR(B.LST_DB_CHG_DTM,7,2) AS "upd_dtm" , 1 AS "searchyn" FROM SGEOWN.MSGE006ITM A INNER JOIN SGEOWN.MSGE007ITF B ON A.AMSYS_ATFL_ID = B.AMSYS_ATFL_ID WHERE 1=1 AND A.DAT_USG_YN='Y' AND B.DAT_USG_YN='Y' AND B.AMSYS_ATFL_LCA_TXT LIKE '/%' AND B.AMSYS_ATFL_LCA_TXT NOT LIKE '/ABC%' AND B.AMSYS_ATFL_LCA_TXT NOT LIKE '/OTR%' AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(B.AMSYS_ATFL_LCA_TXT, '^/[0-9]{8}$') AND A.AMSYS_ATFL_ID= :amsysAtflId AND B.ATFL_SRNO= :atflSrno ORDER BY A.AMSYS_ATFL_ID ASC, B.ATFL_SRNO ASC
